newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela sets 100 bln bolivar TEM bill auction.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela sets 100 bln bolivar TEM bill auction.

text.p: The Central Bank of Venezuela announced for Monday morning a 100 billion bolivar auction of 179-, 269- and 360-day "monetary stabilization," or TEM, bills at nominal interest rates of up to 16.92 percent.

The bank said it would offer 70 billion bolivars worth of 179-day bills with a nominal interest rate of 16.26 percent, 15 billion bolivars of 269-day bills at 16.58 percent and 15 billion bolivars of 360-day bills at 16.92 percent.
At its auction last week, the central bank sold 60 billion bolivars worth of 177, 267- and 358-day bills with yields of 16.24 percent, 17.07 percent and 18.76 percent respectively.
